units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 7:5">Targ. Y. Deut. VII, 5</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 1:19">Targ. Jer. I, 19</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Taanit 20b:11">Taan. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>כל אשיתא … הווה ס׳ לה</he> every threatening wall he ordered to be torn down.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 3b:13">B. Bath. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>לא לִיסְתּוֹר וכ׳</he> one must not tear down a synagogue before having built another one.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 3b:9">Ib.</cite> <he>סֵתְרֵי ובנו</he>, v. <cite ref="O01684"><he>סִתְוָא</he></cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 15:25">Targ. Prov. XV, 25</cite> (Var. ed. Lag. <he>נסטר</he>, corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 11:18">Targ. II Kings XI, 18</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Yevamot 116b:4">Yeb. 116ᵇ</cite> <he>קרע סַתְּרִי מזייך …</he> rend thy garments, disarrange thy hair (in mourning).
<cite ref="Nedarim 50b:7">Ned. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>עד דמְסַתְּרִין וכ׳</he> until the people of his household disarranged their hair for him (in sympathy with his pain).

senses.gloss: to be torn down. Meg. Taan. ch. VIII, v. סוֹרִיגָא.
